shared_rules.priority: State PNG owns composition, hierarchy and visible copy; Shared Foundation supplies only registered shared properties.
shared_rules.medium_candidate: Medium Frozen PNG includes idle and gold-selected card styles. Initial candidates are uncommitted suggestions; selected style follows explicit tap per State Machine.
shared_rules.confidence: Confidence routes the state; no numeric confidence chip is defined by the five Frozen Result PNGs.
shared_rules.media: HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW use original oriented user photo and subject-safe Hero policy. NO_FISH/IMAGE_QUALITY_WARNING use complete Evidence Fit. No stretch, generated fill, blur duplicate, detector crop or screenshot crop.
shared_rules.recovery: NO_FISH and IMAGE_QUALITY_WARNING are distinct static states; neither persists a record.
